cellNumber.rule: Body Coordinate x shifted up twelve bits, ORed with z, as eight decimal digits ($05504E); digit 0 is the most significant.

evidence.claim: MIDAS draws this ground record in every Surface Cell: $04ED2A tiles one $ABDC word and every cell names the same $1E400 record. $055004 doubles each $7000 template offset on this Body alone, so the templates authored half a cell out stand at the centres of the eight neighbouring cells.

model.name: THE MIDAS PROJECT ground
